mutations.name: secrets-not-used
mutations.what: the credentials of the agent are not masked by value

mutations.name: secrets-read-once
mutations.what: the list of credentials is read once, at the start

patches.new:
const fixed = secrets();
  const text = (value) => maskSecrets(String(value), fixed);

mutations.name: string-passed-raw
mutations.what: the value is not turned into a string before it is masked
mutations.equivalent: maskSecrets turns its first argument into a string itself, so the String() here only says so

mutations.name: strings-not-masked
mutations.what: a string of a structure is returned as it is

mutations.name: null-walked
mutations.what: null is walked as an object

patches.old: if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') return value;

mutations.name: cycle-not-cut
mutations.what: a cycle is followed until the depth limit

mutations.name: depth-not-limited
mutations.what: there is no limit to the depth

mutations.name: ancestors-kept
mutations.what: an object stays marked after it was walked, so a second use of it is cut

mutations.name: array-not-walked
mutations.what: the strings of an array are not masked

patches.old: if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((item) => walk(item, depth + 1, ancestors));

mutations.name: object-not-walked
mutations.what: the strings of an object are not masked

mutations.name: unknown-error-text
mutations.what: an error that is nothing says nothing

patches.old: if (error === undefined || error === null) return 'unknown error';

mutations.name: error-with-prefix
mutations.what: an error is given as "Error: words"

mutations.name: cut-text
mutations.what: the text of a cut is another

patches.old: const CUT = '[cut: nested too deeply or circular]';
